16th. SEPTEMBER, 2010 No. S 80

BRUNEI NATIONAL PETROLEUM COMPANY SENDIRIAN BERHAD

ORDER, 2002 (S 6102)

NOTICE OF AMENDMENT OF THE GRANTING OF MINERAL RIGHTS BY

HIS MAJESTY THE SULTAN AND YANG DI-PERTUAN IN COUNCIL [section 3j l)l It is hereby notified that His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan in Council has, on the 16th. March, 2009, renamed the designated area referred to as Block K to be Block CA2. It is hereby further notified that His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan in Council has, pursuant to section 3(1), on the 16th.
